english: You stare at the wondrous wood carving.
A depiction of Urth at his greatest. A true man.
However, you also notice a message carved into the base of the art-piece.
This was not of the artist's intention.
It says 'Goblon was here'.
Heresy. What kind of ingrate would defile a sacred object?
Heh. Seems like Goblon's at work again.
Your work on the statue has cleared up the foul message at the base.
Now just smooth wood remains.
You try to shield your gaze from the horrors of the crack you caused.
You feel like crying.
Good. You're a monster.
The wood statue is forever marked by your hands.
An accurate depiction of Urth, after all. Cracked and broken.
E-My work is done here.
Vandalization. Terrible to see. If you'd been here, you would have stopped it. Surely.
Either way, you must become stronger. To stop this disintegration of society from spreading.
Vandalization. This happened because you are a weak man with a small member.
And the entire world will continue to degrade over the centuries because of it. And it's okay. It's just the way things are.
Famous artist, that guy. Never seen him, but you've definitely seen his work.
A bit rude to just carve his name into the statue like that, but he's known to be a bit of a dick swinger.
I don't have a small member.
It's always small compared to those larger.
The competition never ends.
The dick measuring competition?
The goblin gives you a quick glance back.
Huh?
It's perfectly average.
He squints. "You've been standing there silently for a while now. You're aware I have no context of what you're talking about, right?"
...That's good actually.
Okay? Good. Carry on.
(Turn back to the statue.) Anyway, where were we?
The competition.
Right. Dick measuring competition.
Yes.
You should view this more as a metaphor.
That's probably healthier.
Why am I thinking about this?
You're a man. You can't just not think about it.
Who doesn't think about cocks a couple of times a day?
The phallic nature of the statue must invoke it.
This train of thought is dumb. Suits you, but dumb.
If you truly worry so much, there are potions and spells for this.
An esoteric man need not worry about physical matters.
You won't.
You wouldn't.
As much as I'd love to see you try, no one can even get to him.
The guy's as elusive as an ethereal spider.
Really?
Yeah. This is an old monument. It's fine. The past is the past.
(Contain your tears.) "Yeah. It's fine."
He squints and nods, slowly.
Sure.
Goblon is an artist. He's technically wanted in most districts.
You've seen his mark around the city many times.
But no one even knows if he's real.
Might be a dozen little guys running around with paint and carving tools. Who knows?
Death and decay. Like the rest of the world.
Nothing the world hasn't already done.
Oh yes. You're cleaning the world, one message at a time.
You've done almost nothing. But it is something.
Hells yeah! You sure did great. Only problem?
You did it for free. Like some welfare janitor.
Next time, give a quote.
Humans sure do like their wooden stuff.
Yeah, good job. Expected you to crack the thing in half.
But you didn't!
Yeah. A perfect metaphor.
Cracked in half but still standing.
The goblin is correct.
Albeit morbidly so.
You should! It's only right for The Cleric to clean up such a mess.
Is this really your duty?
Easy job!
You should be worried about the work involved here.
You'd have to take that carving knife by the candles, and...
Can the Yellow One be trusted with this important mission?
Your faith needs to be strong.
Attempt to remove the 'Goblon' message from the statue.
Does this really have to be a sleight of hand-thing? Can't I... use the power of my faith or something?
What're you going to do, close your eyes and pray?
If you want to clean this old wooden thing up, you've got to handle it carefully.
No...
Prayer does work. Just put your trust into Urth. He will guide you.
Yes. This is not something you can solve with faith.
Trust the artisan within.
(Trust your faith.)
(Trust your faith.)
(No. Trust your abilities.)
(No. Trust your abilities.)
Yes. Perhaps you can...
No. This was a bad idea.
That's the spirit!
Now let's get to work...
That's the spirit.
Might be slightly misplaced spirit, but still!
Fair. Your hands are pretty shaky.
Fine. Do as you wish.
You start working.
Picking up the tiny carving knife, the same that was used to scratch the wood.
You can clean this up real quick...
(Spend 10 minutes working on it.)
With dexterous fingers you precisely carve a layer off the statue.
Within a few minutes the message is entirely gone.
Glorious. Wonderful work.
Hanging on to a dead god. It's sad.
Sad? It's a tragedy. But that does not mean we can forget his legacy.
Fine craftsmanship is what it is.
You could've been a wood carver in another life!
If it was in any way a lucrative career, that is.
SHE always spoke lowly of artistic endeavors.
One of many things you did not agree with when it comes to your mother.
Grabbing the tiny carving knife, the same that was used to scratch the wood.
You can clean this up in no time at all! Just get to work.
(Start working.)
Just one... little...
A crack and a snap.
That sound will haunt you until the final gate is closed.
That sound will haunt you until the day you die.
As the splinters and dust settle, your eyes land upon it.
The split.
<shake>Geezus</shake>!
You...
Urth is dead, and you have killed him.
Is this what being a part of a weak, dead culture feels like...?
Whoops!
What... what have I DONE?!
You've got dust in your eyes. In your mouth.
What a fuck-up.
I'm such a fuck-up.
You are.
Remember how he screamed at you?
The patriarch doesn't fuck around - you really should have run.
Run from the towers?
Oh yeah. Run from the towers.
For gods' sake, you got caught using city-funded paper and prints to write FREESTRIDER op-eds.
You're lucky they didn't find the other dozen you'd already sent out.
<shake>Dereliction</shake>.
Bjôrn gave you a pat on the back as you got called in.
Remember his grin? That piece of shit loved every second of it.
When the grilling was over, the Patriarch ripped your rank. But he didn't exile you.
He obviously didn't have the power to do so. Stripping a high-tier esoteric-expert cleric of his rank is like robbing a bank to pay off a loan. You're just gonna end up with more shit on your shoes.
Unless you're a lucky motherfucker. Which you clearly are.
Right. That's why-
That's why you're doing this grunt work.
But hey, could be worse.
Could be a sender.
The goblin taps you on the back as you get up.
Look, it's just a statue.
No one will notice the, uh, crack, he says and glares at the massive ravine you caused in the wood.
So don't worry about it.
(Look at the crack in the statue.)
Yeah. No worries.
Nobody cares about an old dead god anyhow.
(Whimper.)
Yeah... it'll be fine. No one will know.
You look upon the ruined symbol of Urth with a heavy heart.
Blood has been spilled. It should have been yours.
This feels... bad.
FEARS. UNLOCKED.
